posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: I am now heading to China, from the Philippines, where we had a wonderful meeting on Trade, National Security, and other subjects. I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different Trade Deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark and, in particular, a Deal that will be great for our Farmers and those in the business of “Energy.” President Marcos is a powerful leader, and a man of high integrity and substance. It was an Honor to be with him, and his beautiful wife and son. See you in China! President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Commissioner Rob Manfred said that Major League Baseball was prepared to go to war over its proposed salary cap — a system the players have long said they will not accept.

The collective bargaining agreement expires Dec. 1, potentially leading to a lockout.
posts.text_ko:
롭 만프레드 커미셔너는 메이저 리그 야구가 제안된 연봉 상한선을 두고 전쟁을 벌일 준비가 되어 있다고 말했습니다. 선수들은 오랫동안 이 시스템을 받아들이지 않을 것이라고 말했습니다.

단체 교섭 협약은 12월 1일에 만료되며 직장 폐쇄로 이어질 가능성이 있습니다.

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Last year, singer-songwriter Sara Bareilles recorded her first album in years, “Good Grief,” in the midst of loss. She was navigating infertility and the deaths of two dear friends.

The album became a way to “put your love somewhere,” she said.
posts.text_ko:
지난해 싱어송라이터 사라 바렐레스(Sara Bareilles)는 상실감 속에서 수년 만에 첫 앨범 'Good Grief'를 녹음했다. 그녀는 불임과 두 명의 소중한 친구의 죽음을 겪고 있었습니다.

이 앨범은 “당신의 사랑을 어딘가에 두는” 방법이 되었다고 그녀는 말했습니다.
